name: BACH_0261
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier-4 biopsy with singleton conformal set [F1], though 5/5 nearest neighbors are Normal [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, others 0% (ECE 5%) | Zero invasive risk; small test set |
| Conformal set | {Benign}, 90% target (90% coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 99% reliability, 8% OOD, 12/12 kept [F6] (AUROC 70%) | Typical image; passes quality checks |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign; 5/5 Normal (93%–94% similarity) | Nearest neighbors are all Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Top benign driver (-1.81) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (+0.88) pushing toward invasive [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Text-only score (-0.48); lacks CAV [F4] · Weak
- **Benign epithelial fraction** (regions 3, 7, 11) · context · 0% epithelium (1st percentile) [F7]; wrong-direction feature · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in deletion test (CI +0.0021 to +0.0197 excludes 0); region 3 risk is 0.001.
- **Concepts**: Unverified in deletion test (CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); relies on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- All 5 nearest neighbors are Normal (93%–94% similarity), so paucicellular tissue is Normal, not Benign.
- Validated stromal infiltration in regions 3, 7, 11 (+0.88) reflects focal invasion missed globally.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 7, 11**: Check right column for stromal infiltration versus fibrous stroma around 4 neoplastic nuclei.
2. **Regions 3, 7, 10**: Confirm whether two-layered lobules or Normal stroma explain 0% epithelial nuclei.
3. **Regions 4, 6, 8**: Verify benign gland or tubule architecture where text-only tubule scores peak.
